import pathlib,os,sys
pids=[]
for d in pathlib.Path("/proc").iterdir():
 if not d.name.isdigit():continue
 try:
  args=(d/"cmdline").read_bytes().replace(b"\0",b" ").decode("utf-8","replace")
  if "tumblrkit.appserve" in args and "serve" in args and "--port 8081" in args:pids.append(d)
 except (OSError,PermissionError):pass
if len(pids)!=1:print("TUMBLR_PROCESS_UNIQUE=NO");sys.exit(30)
env=(pids[0]/"environ").read_bytes().split(b"\0")
def get(name):
 prefix=name.encode()+b"="
 return next((e[len(prefix):] for e in env if e.startswith(prefix)),b"")
blog=get("TUMBLR_OWNER_BLOG")
path=get("TUMBLR_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE")
print("OWNER_BLOG_CONFIGURED="+("YES" if blog else "NO"))
print("OAUTH_TOKEN_PATH_CONFIGURED="+("YES" if path else "NO"))
valid=False
if path:
 try:
  f=pathlib.Path(os.fsdecode(path)).expanduser()
  valid=f.is_file() and not f.is_symlink() and f.stat().st_mode & 0o077==0
 except (OSError,ValueError):pass
print("OWNER_TOKEN_FILE_PROTECTED="+("YES" if valid else "NO"))
print("READ_ONLY_CHECK=PASS")
PY
